_README: Copy this file to config.json (gitignored) and edit. This is the SINGLE place you parameterize the skill for your species, site, and preferences. Nothing species- or brand-specific should live in the Python.

project.name: Roof Rat Laws
project.hub_title: Are Roof Rats Legal? Laws by Country & State

counterpart._note: Optional. The closely-related species people DO commonly keep, used for the 'is the domestic-X exemption only for the counterpart?' analysis. Omit if not applicable.
counterpart.note: the common pet rat; many 'domestic rat' exemptions name only it

seo._note: rank_math | yoast | none. 'none' uses the bundled mu-plugin to register the meta keys so core WP REST can write them.

plugin._note: Optional companion plugin. If use=false, the skill publishes via core WP REST + the mu-plugin SEO fallback.

research._note: gemini_available: tell the agent whether Gemini Pro Deep Research is an option for you. default_engine: 'auto' lets the agent recommend the best engine per jurisdiction; else 'gemini' | 'claude' | 'manual'. If Gemini is unavailable the agent always falls back to the best available (Claude deep-research / web-search).

inquiries._note: Sending written inquiries to agencies is OPTIONAL but highly recommended. Off by default; the agent SUGGESTS turning it on when an audit finds a clarification-worthy gap. confirm_each keeps you in control: nothing is ever sent without your per-query confirm/edit.

attribution._note: Optional, understated 'gift' credit on your published pages. Set footer_optin=false to omit entirely.
attribution.footer_html: Built with Pet Freedom — a gift from the roof-rat community.
